from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
import time

def get_deal(url):
    driver = webdriver.Chrome()
    driver.get(url)

    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 10)
    deal = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.XPATH, "//div[@class='deal']")))

    return deal

def apply_deal(deal):
    apply_link = deal.find_element(By.XPATH, "//a[@class='apply-deal']")
    apply_link.click()

def main():
    url = input("Enter Black Friday deal URL: ")
    deal = get_deal(url)
    apply_deal(deal)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

from flask import Flask, request, jsonify
from flask_sqlalchemy import SQLAlchemy

app = Flask(__name__)
app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] ='sqlite:///candidates.db'
db = SQLAlchemy(app)

class Candidate(db.Model):
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    name = db.Column(db.String(80), nullable=False)
    email = db.Column(db.String(120), unique=True, nullable=False)
    race = db.Column(db.String(80))
    gender = db.Column(db.String(80))
    orientation = db.Column(db.String(80))

@app.route('/add_candidate', methods=['POST'])
def add_candidate():
    name = request.form['name']
    email = request.form['email']
    race = request.form['race']
    gender = request.form['gender']
    orientation = request.form['orientation']

    candidate = Candidate(name=name, email=email, race=race, gender=gender, orientation=orientation)
    db.session.add(candidate)
    db.session.commit()

    return jsonify({'status':'success'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()

    latitude = db.Column(db.Float, nullable=False)
    longitude = db.Column(db.Float, nullable=False)

class LocationSchema(ma.Schema):
    class Meta:
        fields = ('id', 'user_id', 'latitude', 'longitude')

schema = LocationSchema()

@app.route('/update_location', methods=['POST'])
def update_location():
    data = request.get_json()
    location = schema.load(data).data
    db.session.execute(f"UPDATE locations SET latitude = {location.latitude}, longitude = {location.longitude} WHERE id = {location.id}")
    db.session.commit()
    return jsonify({'status':'success'})

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app.run()

import hashlib
import os

def crack_password(password):
    salt = os.urandom(16)
    hashed_password = hashlib.sha256(salt + password.encode()).hexdigest()
    return salt, hashed_password

def check_password(hashed_password, password):
    salt = hashed_password[:32]
    stored_hash = hashed_password[32:]
    new_hash = hashlib.sha256(salt + password.encode()).hexdigest()
    return new_hash == stored_hash

import yfinance as yf
import pandas as pd

def get_historical_data(ticker):
    data = yf.download(ticker, period='1y')
    return data

def calculate_bollinger_bands(data):
    data['20ma'] = data['Close'].rolling(window=20).mean()
    data['std'] = data['Close'].rolling(window=20).std()
    data['upper_band'] = data['20ma'] + (2 * data['std'])
    data['lower_band'] = data['20ma'] - (2 * data['std'])
    return data

def analyze_bollinger_bands(data):
    if data['Close'][-1] > data['upper_band'][-1]:
        return "Bullish"
    elif data['Close'][-1] < data['lower_band'][-1]:
        return "Bearish"
    else:
        return "Neutral"

def trade(ticker):
    data = get_historical_data(ticker)
    data = calculate_bollinger_bands(data)
    analysis = analyze_bollinger_bands(data)
    print(f"Bollinger Bands Analysis for {ticker}: {analysis}")

from email.mime.multipart import MIMEMultipart
from email.mime.text import MIMEText

def send_message(subject, message, from_addr, to_addr, password):
    msg = MIMEMultipart()
    msg['From'] = from_addr
    msg['To'] = to_addr
    msg['Subject'] = subject
    msg.attach(MIMEText(message))

    server = smtplib.SMTP('smtp.gmail.com', 587)
    server.starttls()
    server.login(from_addr, password)
    text = msg.as_string()
    server.sendmail(from_addr, to_addr, text)
    server.quit()
